campaigns.title: Help provide shelter, food, clothes and medical support to abandoned widow mothers of Vrindavan. Donate now
campaigns.description: In Vrindavan, thousands of elderly widow mothers face the harsh reality of abandonment and suffering. With no one to turn to, many are left begging on the streets, exposed to heat, cold and rain,Donate so that Maitri can provide shelter, food, clothes and medical support to abandoned elderly mothers now. Give generously.Winnie Singh has witnessed many cases of widow mothers being abandoned on the streets of Vrindavan, one of the holiest places in India. “Children leave their mothers as soon as they become widows. The children start feeling the burden. This has become a practice in today's society that money comes first and everything else later,” says Winnie whose Maitri India, rescues widowed mothers from the streets of Vrindavan.Many widowed elderly mothers often end up living a lonely life and begging to survive on the streets. And Maitri aspires to take care of every widow in need of help, but because of lack of funds, Winnie and Maitri are in a position to do it."Elderly widows don't have shelter. They sleep in cowsheds over sacks. They don't have a blanket. Nights are really difficult for them," shares Winnie Singh. Maitri aims to:Provide shelter and nutritious meals leading to improved health and wellbeingMake physical and mental health services accessibleOffer necessary quality aged care and assisted living supportIncrease awareness and engagement around the struggles of abandoned widow mothersWhy donate to MaitriWinnie needs your support to help those in need of food, healthcare and well-being. “Maitri urgently needs your support to provide nutritious food, clothing and healthcare to sustain these widow mothers who are prone to more illnesses as they age,” appeals Winnie. “You can become the family they were denied. Hold their hands so they don't need to beg ever again,” she adds. Let’s rescue abandoned widows mothers from the streets of Vrindavan and give them a better future. Donate now.Our help will enable Maitri to save hundreds of abandoned widows from a life of begging, and restore the respect, dignity, and identity they deserve.

campaigns.title: Help Gopalan of Akshaya Trust feed and care for rescued abandoned elderly parents
campaigns.description: “Parvathi Amma (name changed) was brought to Akshaya Trust by her son. He brought her here saying she was being taken to the hospital for treatment and he would be back in a while. It's been 8 years since that day. The phone number he gave to us was made up, even his address was false. Imagine the pain of the mother who was abandoned in such a heartless manner. She is not the only one. We have over 260 elderly parents here and most of them have faced abandonment, neglect or even abuse”, says G Gopalan, the founder of Akshaya Trust, the NGO taking care of abandoned seniors who have no one else in the world.Without Gopalan’s Akshaya Trust, countless elderly would still be on the streets or simply deprived of the love and care they deserve. The NGO takes care of every single need of its seniors from Food to medical care and housing. Your donation can enable Akshaya Trust to reach out to many more elderly with food and support. Contribute generously. Donate easily through UPI, all debit/credit cards and net banking. Charitable donations to this fundraising campaign are tax exempted under 80G of the Income Tax Act (India).G Gopalan, a well-to-do businessman preferred to serve the elderly than living a peaceful retired life. He says that he was too shocked to see the state of the elderly, treated shabbily by their own children.A lifeline for hundreds of neglected elderlyToday, Akshaya Trust offers a safe haven to over 260 elderly parents, shielding them from the harsh realities of street life. This organization attends to all their needs, providing comprehensive medical care and ensuring they recover from past traumas. The trust also organises joyful celebrations during festivals and special occasions, bringing happiness into their lives.To date, Akshaya Trust has served over 1,000 elderly parents most of whom were from extremely weak financial backgrounds and had no way to fend for themselves. Akshaya Trust: A silver lining for elderlyAkshaya Trust’s efforts are a lifeline for these seniors, but they rely heavily on public support to continue. You can be the hero these elderly parents deserve. Donate now to help care for them.Your contribution can transform the lives of many homeless seniors. Support Akshaya Trust’s mission today.Donate to this fundraiser on Give.do, India’s largest and most trusted online donation platform, to help elderly parents abandoned by their children get the love and care they deserve.

campaigns.title: Help Vinay bring children facing abuse in red-light areas to safety and protect them
campaigns.description: “I saw a girl, barely 7 or 8, being pushed into flesh trade. Her cries for help still echo in my ears. There were men as old as 60 r*ping the innocent child. That was the day I knew my mission in life was to get these children out of the hell-like conditions in red-light areas. They are nothing short of hell and no child deserves to grow up in this environment” says Vinay Vasta, founder of Social Activities Integration, an organisation committed to freeing children trapped in red-light areas.Vinay and his NGO have been able to provide education, medical care and nutrition to over 2,500 children. But his dream to provide safe shelter to children remains unrealized. “We do our best to keep these children safe during the day but sadly they are forced to go back to the red light areas at night as we don’t have a home for them. Your donation can help us build a safe home for children of sex workers and prevent them from being pulled into prostitution. Donate to make this dream a realityDonate easily through UPI, all debit/credit cards and net banking. Charitable donations to this fundraising campaign are tax exempted under 80G of the Income Tax Act (India).Life in red light areas“S*x workers use their homes which are barely 6 feet by 4 feet for their business. They invite customers in the presence of their children. Their children not only witness abuse but experience it too. Just imagine a child being told that all she can ever become in life is a pr*stitute”, Vinay shares as he explains the extent of abuse children face in red light areas.This is a life that thousands of children are forced to live behind closed doors where they suffer abuse and exploitation morning, noon and night.A ray of hopeVinay has been relentlessly trying to give children the care and education they deserve. He has provided quality English education to thousands of children, enabling them to secure a livelihood out of red-light areas. Several children taught by Vinay are today leading successful lives as professionals and Government employees. However the sad reality is that Vinay and his NGO, in the absence of a permanent shelter home, are unable to provide round the clock safety to these children, which is essential for their well-being.Your donations can enable SAI to build a shelter home for the children of sex workers and usher in a new tomorrow for them, away from the horrors of red-light areas.Donate to this fundraiser on Give.do, India’s largest and most trusted online donation platform, to provide safe shelter for children of sex workers and save them from abuse and second generation pr*stitution.NGO's 80G number: AACTS0408EF20216NGO's 12A number: AACTS0408EE20028

campaigns.title: URGENT!! People of Assam need urgent help as floods leave lakhs in need. Donate now
campaigns.description: People of Assam need urgent help as floods leave lakhs in need. Donate nowFloodwaters have once again ravaged the beautiful land of Assam, leaving a trail of destruction in its wake. According to the latest reports by the Assam State Disaster Management Authority (ASDMA), over six lakh people have been severely affected by floods across Charaideo, Golaghat, Jorhat, Nagaon, Sivasagar, and other districts. The number of victims of the natural disaster has climbed to over 70, while thousands remain stranded without help. Together, let us rise and make a difference by contributing to our fundraising campaign for the flood victims of Assam.Charaideo is the worst-hit district with nearly 1.9 lakh people affected, followed by Sivasagar (over 1.5 lakh) and Jorhat (around 1.4 lakh). Nestled in the northeastern part of India, Assam has a long-standing history of facing nature's fury. Just last year, the state witnessed a devastating flood that uprooted the lives of countless individuals. This year, the floods have struck again, plunging numerous families into unimaginable chaos and distress. Many have been displaced from their homes, left without shelter, and robbed of their basic necessities.Embankments, roads, bridges and other infrastructure have also been damaged by flood waters. The urgent need for assistance:In times like these, it is our duty to extend a helping hand to our fellow human beings who are facing the wrath of nature. Your generous donations will directly support our on-ground NGO partners who are tirelessly working to provide immediate relief to the flood-affected people in Assam. The funds raised will be utilised to provide them with essential supplies such as food, clean water, and medical care, bringing hope and solace to their lives during this moment of crisis.The power of your donations:Every rupee contributed to this fundraising campaign will create a ripple effect of positive change in the lives of those who need it the most. Your support will help in:Immediate Relief: Ensuring that the affected families receive immediate assistance in the form of food, clean water, and essential supplies.Medical Care: Providing medical aid to those injured or suffering from waterborne diseases, ensuring their well-being in the aftermath of the disaster.Shelter and Rehabilitation: Assisting in the construction of temporary shelters and facilitating the process of rehabilitation to help affected families rebuild their lives.Here's how your donations can help:a) A food kit comprising essential supplies can be provided for ₹1,255. b) A hygiene kit with essentials for an entire family during floods can be ensured for ₹1,035. c) Our NGO partner can provide temporary shelter for flood-affected families for ₹2,570.Now is the time to unite and show our solidarity with the people of Assam. By donating to our fundraising campaign, you are not just providing immediate relief; you are also offering hope and strength to those who have lost everything. Together, we can make a difference and rebuild the lives of the flood-affected communities in Assam. Join us today and let compassion guide our actions.Thanks to you, here are a few images of ActionAid providing help to people in need in Assam!

campaigns.title: Help NGO Purnata rescue children from horrors of red-light areas and give them urgent care
campaigns.description: “Preeti (name changed) was just six when she was brought to Mumbai and only nine when she was sold into Kamathipura’s red-light area. We rescued her a few years later, but by then, she had already endured unimaginable trauma. Her stories broke my heart. That’s when I resolved to dedicate my life to ending the trafficking and exploitation of children,” says Aaboo Varghese, who left a successful corporate career to take up this fight. “Preeti tragically lost her life years later to HIV, a result of the abuse she suffered as a child,” Aaboo sharesAaboo has dedicated his life to saving children from the horrors of red light areas, but he can not do it alone. With your support, he can bring freedom and light into the lives of many more unfortunate victims of child trafficking. Support him now!Donate easily through UPI, all debit/credit cards and net banking. Charitable donations to this fundraising campaign are tax exempted under 80G of the Income Tax Act (India).A crisis of mammoth proportionsThe scale of human trafficking is something most people cannot even imagine. “Every day, about six children are trafficked. This is a fast-growing business because unlike anything else, a human being can be sold over and over again. It is alarming and heart-wrenching,” Aaboo shares.But no matter how daunting the task might be Aaboo has made it his life mission to see the fight against human trafficking till the end. Living in a hell on earth“The abuse young girls face in red-light areas is beyond comprehension,” Aaboo shares. “These young girls are robbed of their innocence and their childhood. Traffickers beat them with rods, burn them, and mutilate their private parts just to break them. Children are kept in separate apartments where multiple men abuse them and get addicted to substances”, Aaboo says. Through his NGO Purnata, Aaboo is on a mission not just to rescue the victims from red-light areas but also to rehabilitate them and give them a fresh start in life. To date, he has saved 85 children and 60 women from red-light areas, but for him, the job is far from over. Aaboo has dedicated his life to this cause. Your contribution can strengthen his efforts. Donate generously!  What your donations can doYour support can enable Aaboo to strengthen Purnata’s on-ground outreach programmes so that they can save a child as soon as she is brought to red-light areas. The NGO will also be able to invest in their rehabilitation programme, which provides training and education to rescued victims of trafficking. You can also play a critical role in bringing to an end second-generation trafficking so that the cycle of exploitation can come to an end once and for all. Donate to this fundraiser by give.do, India’s most trusted online donation platform, to support Purnata in its mission to rescue and rehabilitate victims of human trafficking.

campaigns.title: Help visually impaired Shivaprakash give 40 blind girls shelter, education and care
campaigns.description: At the age of 8, Shivaprakash lost his vision. But what could have become a life of despair became something else entirely. Shivaprakash went on to complete his Master’s degree and eventually founded the Divya Jyothi Charitable Trust, an organisation born out of personal struggle and driven by a powerful mission, to educate and empower blind girls, who are among the most neglected and marginalised in society.In many families, blind daughters are hidden away, seen as a burden, and in some cases, even as a curse. They are denied the right to dream, grow, or be independent. At Divya Jyothi, Shivaprakash is changing that narrative. Your support can ensure that no blind girl is left behind simply because of her disability. Donate today to help them stand tall, proud, and self-reliant. Donate nowDonate easily through UPI, all debit/credit cards and net banking. Charitable donations to this fundraising campaign are tax exempted under 80G of the Income Tax Act (India).Education is survivalIn communities where gender and disability intersect, blind girls face deep-rooted prejudice and extreme isolation. Many are denied even basic schooling and are left dependent on family members for the rest of their lives. Recognising this, Divya Jyothi began with a simple yet radical step: to provide blind girls with computer training so they could access the digital world and open doors to employment.But the journey didn’t stop there. The NGO went on to launch a braille transcription centre, ensuring girls have access to learning materials that suit their needs. As Shivaprakash says, “Without education, no one can do anything. That's why education is even more important for blind girls.” Education isn’t just about literacy, it’s about self-worth, decision-making, mobility, and freedom. It’s about giving these girls the same right to participate in society that sighted individuals often take for granted.From rejection to respectIn a country where blind girls are often treated as liabilities, Divya Jyothi is rewriting their futures. Over 1,000 girls have graduated from the Trust’s training centres. Many of them come from families that had almost given up on them. Today, these same girls are government employees, corporate professionals, and role models in their communities.More than 200 graduates have secured jobs in the public sector. Over 300 are now employed in private companies. Every success story is proof that with the right support, blind girls don’t just survive, they thrive. “Most girls are neglected by their families. This is a major challenge for them,” says Shivaprakash. By providing them with skills and confidence, Divya Jyothi is turning neglect into empowerment and helplessness into hope.Donate to help 40 blind girls find independenceAlmost 40 girls are currently enrolled and will directly benefit from your support. These are girls with potential, courage, and ambition—but they lack the resources to pursue an independent life. “I request each one to come forward and donate to help blind girls lead independent lives in society,” urges Shivaprakash.Help Divya Jyothi Charitable Trust break the cycle of neglect. Your donation can give a blind girl her first lesson, her first job, and a life of dignity.Donate to this fundraiser by Give, India’s most trusted online donation platform, to support Divya Jyothi Charitable Trust in its mission to shelter and educate neglected and abandoned blind girls.

campaigns.title: Help abandoned elderly with shelter and care
campaigns.description: Every day, elderly parents are left alone on the streets, at train stations, or even outside temples. Many are sick, struggling with age-related problems, and have no money or family to turn to. Some suffer for weeks or months before anyone notices their pain. The heartbreaking truth? They were abandoned by their own families.Although Indian law requires children and relatives to care for senior citizens, many elders still face neglect, abuse, and abandonment. The problem is only getting worse.But there is hope. Our dedicated NGO partners work day and night to rescue these forgotten elders. They provide safe shelter, medical care, nutritious meals, and most importantly—love and respect. Through old age homes across the country, our partners give these seniors a chance to live their remaining years with dignity, comfort, and peace.You can make a difference. Your donation will help our NGO partners:Rescue homeless elders from the streetsProvide shelter, food, and medical careRestore their faith in humanity with kindness and supportNo elder should spend their final years alone and suffering. Your generosity can give them a fresh start. Donate today and help an abandoned senior citizen find safety, care, and hope.

campaigns.title: Sponsor Living Expenses for Single Women
campaigns.description:
The women in the age group of 18-35 years are living single due to destitute, divorced, widowed, separated, unmarried, infected/affected with HIV/AIDS, survivors of violence against women (VAW) living single, and living separately with disabilities. These women lead their families by doing daily labor, wage workers, and street vendors, but they get limited daily income, and due to the nonavailability of work, they have no workdays in a month; as a result, they don’t have income those days; this will lead these families to severe poverty conditions. Hence, the young single women searching for alternative income sources and trapped by the middlemen to use them as sex workers while they are involved in sex work, infected with HIV/AIDS, and facing many other health issues; they lose their dignity in the society, they can’t do further for labor work to generate income for their family. Mahila Margadarshi conducted a study with these families about their income sources and wellbeing; we identified that most of these women have various skills in sewing, food preparation, little shops, skilled in developing backyard poultry, and trading with goat/sheep lambs. But, due to a lack of financial feasibility, these women are working as unskilled labor and getting insufficient income to manage their families. Due to the situation, the family members face no food days and become malnourished. This will affect the lives of these families. 
 The proposed project ‘Living Expenses for a Single Women Family’ addresses the poverty issue among 100 single women families and provide financial assistance to the women according to their skill to earn money at their home, provide financial aid to developing backyard poultry, purchase goat/sheep lambs for rearing, buy a sewing machine for income generation, start a little shop at home to lead by their parents. The financial aid to these single women will bring them out of the severe poverty conditions and improve their dignity in society; Mahila Margadarshi will take responsibility for protecting the young single women from the middlemen and take the lead role in accessing the benefits of all Government Schemes. 
 The project will address the issues of poverty and dignity, the project beneficiaries will improve their family income which will lead to zero hunger days in a month, and the young single women will start their enterprise at home to earn income and prevent the pressure from the middlemen in the society; as a result, they are not infected with HIV/AIDs and reduce the rate HIV infections, the survivors of Violence Against Women will stand firm for accessing justice.

campaigns.title: Nutrition & Medicines to Support Rural Pregnant Women for Safe Labour / Delivery
campaigns.description:
In our working area, the deprived rural women, especially the pregnant are in pathetic-vulnerable condition. As they are infected by pandemic disease, the pregnant women are having poor health status and immunity. Thus it is the timely need to support them by providing multivitamins and nutritional products for making them gain strength and assisting medical supports and timely guidance till her delivery. However the Government has given supplementary nutrition to the local village level Balwadis which is given to children but not to pregnant women specifically. Hence this project helps them to providing supplementary Nutrition and Medicines during her pregnancy period, improved their health status and immunity power and helps her to make her labour / delivery in a safe and secured manner. 
 We would like to give the support for 6 months (Two Trimesters). Pregnancy is confirmed around the 3rd month, we look after the women in their last 2 trimesters) We have identified about 178 women are currently in Pregnancy and Caring status in our working block those are poor living conditions who unable to meet their daily expenses, they are struggling for their daily breads and unable to access their health care measures, especially by intake of nutrition food and medicines.. The health and education status of them are very poor.By this project, we have to give “Supplementary Nutritional Pack” which contains, pulses, cereals and greens vegetables, dry fruits etc., and a Medicines kit including Folic Tablets, Vitamin Capsules, Multi Vitamin Tablets, Zinc Tonic etc.,. Each of the 20 women which we would like to support this project will be provided by these items at free of cost and this Supplementary Nutrition Pack and Medicines Kit will be given to Pregnant women for 6 months period (Two Trimesters from 3rd month of pregnancy)We have so far supported 18 (pregnant women infected by HIV/AIDS) cases during the year 2017 & 2018 through various health welfare schemes of government and private agencies We have already good follow-up in our Field through the ORW and we have regular touch they are coming and we are going to their houses so it is not difficult us to meet the every month and taking them to hospital.Under this program we have to support only minimum quantity and restricted population of women in our working area but we need to cover additional women beneficiaries whom are intend need. So as we made this donation option for continuing this project. 
 This option helps to improve the Health status of the rurally poor Pregnant women and affected by HIV/ AIDS and Anemic causes. By providing “Supplementary Nutritional Pack” which contains, pulses, cereals and greens vegetables, dry fruits etc., and a Medicines kit including Folic Tablets, Vitamin Capsules, Multi Vitiamin Tablets, Zinc Tonic etc.,. Each of the 20 women which we would like to support this project will be provided by these items at free of cost and this Supplementary Nutrition Pack and Medicines Kit will be given to Pregnant women for 6 months period (Two Trimesters from 3rd month of pregnancy) will certainly helps to improve their health status and Immunity power and prepared them physically fit to make a very Safe, Secure and normal delivery during labour.
